_comment: Readiness check (engine/readiness.js): which reasons make a case or sim 'Needs work' (blocking) and which are only notes. Codes: broken-references (an order, event or reaction points at something missing), variant-errors (the variant check found a variant that behaves differently from the case as written), range-warnings (a range could put a variant past a threshold), unreviewed-case (the whole case is still a draft, review: proposed), tools-unavailable (an order needs an assessment tool the program doesn't offer), partial-review (parts still drafts), proposed-items (individual drafted items), no-script (no reactive script), empty-group, missing-case. Draft for the instructor (SPEC §14).

messages.variant-errors: A variant behaves differently from the case as written: {detail}
messages.range-warnings: A range could break the script: {detail}
messages.unreviewed-case: The whole case is still a draft (not reviewed by an instructor)
messages.partial-review: Parts of the case are still drafts
messages.no-script: No reactive script: the patient won't react to care on its own (you can still drive it from the Overview)
messages.tools-unavailable: Needs assessment tool(s) your program doesn't offer: {detail}
messages.missing-case: Case not found in the library: {detail}
